## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting user behaviour. Link the issue if one exists.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes (includes TypeScript checking).
- [ ] Relevant checks in `docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md` were completed.

For UI changes, include before/after screenshots and the workflows, viewport sizes, and personas checked. For behaviour changes, describe the meaningful regression coverage.

## Limitations

Record any known gaps, data/schema implications, or follow-up work. Remove this section when none applies.
